camel_example: aliyun hbr AddContainerCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Identifier cca8f35f0e0d84540b49d994511c2c87a --NetworkType VPC --ClusterType ACK
description_en: Registers a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun hbr add-container-cluster --identifier cca8f35f0e0d84540b49d994511c2c87a --cluster-type ACK --network-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddContainerCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster that you want to register
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en: The type of the cluster. Only Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) clusters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 集群类型，仅支持ACK，表示阿里云容器服务
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the cluster. Valid values:

CLASSIC: the classic network
VPC: a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值包括：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: network_type

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request is successful

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the request is successful, a value of successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful.

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

Token.description_en: The token that is used to register the Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) client in the cluster
Token.description_zh: 集群token，用于集群中hbr客户端注册使用
